paper_title: Tight Lower Bound on the Probability of a Binomial Exceeding its Expectation
text:
\begin{corollary}[A lower bound at the binomial mean]
Let $m$ be a positive integer, let $0\leq p\leq1$ satisfy
$p<1-1/m$, and let $X\sim B(m,p)$. Then
\[
\mathbb{P}\!\left(X\leq\mathbb{E}[X]\right)>\frac14,
\qquad \mathbb{E}[X]=mp.
\]
\end{corollary}
